newsitem.title: FRANCE: Salman Rushdie to address French deputies.
newsitem.headline: Salman Rushdie to address French deputies.

text.p: British author Salman Rushdie, under a death sentence from Iran for his novel "The Satanic Verses", will testify before a committee of the French National Assembly next week, an assembly aide said on Thursday.
Rushdie was invited to appear at the public hearing by Socialist deputy Jack Lang, chairman of the assembly's Foreign Affairs Committee, the aide said.
The Indian-born writer has lived in hiding since 1989 when Iran's late spiritual leader Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini ordered his death for alleged blasphemy to Islam in his novel.
The invitation comes at a time of frayed relations between Iran and France and its European partners.

The European Union pursued a policy of "critical dialogue" with Iran until all EU states but Greece withdrew their ambassadors from Tehran in April following a German court ruling that Iran's leaders ordered political killings in Berlin in 1992.
